messages:
maya: Quick thread: two-part community push next Wed — tutorial series + reference app launch. Need: short launch post, micro-bench blurb, 30m webinar, and inbound routing. Who picks up what?
leo: I can write the launch post + social snippets. Keep it ~140 words, link to repo, quickstart, and 3 callouts.
anya: I can run the microbench and deliver percent improvements for cache/quant. Will include a 3-row p50/p95/cost table.
build-bot: CI green: refapp v1.1.0 artifacts uploaded to s3://ci/refapp/v1.1.0 (sha256: d4e5f6)
ops: Demo infra provision requested: 3xA10G ephemeral cluster for dry-run Mon 06:00 PT -> expires 72h after launch. Public read-only token available.
sam: Webinar: Wed 11:00 PT, 30m total (15m demo, 10m bench walk, 5m Q&A). I can host and moderate.
maya: Routing: tag leads as "tutorial-blitz-v1.1". High intent if "want-hands-on" + demo-click. Route to AE queue C. Low intent -> 10-day nurture drip.
leo: For the hero metric propose: "~60% lower p95 with KV cache on common prompts" 1; Anya confirm numbers.
anya: Will validate. Also will include a tiny reproduce snippet (<=4 lines) for the post:
```
# quick cache bench
wrk -t2 -c100 -d20s --latency https://demo.redwood.ai/refapp/v1.1/generate
# quant bench
python bench/quant_bench.py --model refapp_v1.1 --seq 256
```
sam: Good. Maya, can we make a short comms timeline?
maya: Post live -> 1h social push -> community email -> webinar signups -> 24h reminder -> webinar. Leo, can you draft email subject lines?
leo: Sure: "Launch: hands-on refapp tutorial + benchmarks" and reminder "Tomorrow: live demo + reproducible benches".
anya: I9ll drop the raw CSV and a 3-row summary into the shared folder by Tue EOD.
ops: Dry-run cluster will be ready Mon 06:00 PT. Please use demo token and avoid long-running jobs.
maya: Owners: leo=post+social+email, anya=bench+metrics, sam=webinar+moderation, ops=infra. Check-in Tue 10:00 PT. Any blockers?
leo: No blockers. PR soon.
anya: None. Running final bench tonight.
sam: All set for slides.
maya: Thanks team :rocket:
